status: Completed; signed ARM64 APK assembled and verified

audiobooks: LibriVox recordings are browsed through Internet Archive first, with the LibriVox API as fallback and cached results during source outages. Categories now launch their search immediately.

Book clicks open a visible detail/loading page immediately. Existing catalog chapters are reused; Archive metadata builds one ordered chapter list without duplicate MP3 encodings. Stored previews open without another catalog request.
Preview state remains visible during library reload, with retry/back on missing chapters; existing books/progress are preserved.
podcasts: Public Apple podcast search replaces the small bundled-only catalog.100 popular public-feed entries are bundled for immediate browsing; live keyword/topic search returns up to200 results with20-row pages and15-minute query caching.
Publisher RSS feeds are cached for5minutes to avoid repeated fetches when reopening a show. Existing subscriptions and added RSS sources are preserved.
youtube: Removed the channel/subscription button from Bookmarks; it remains in Channels.
Refreshes channel metadata after delayed page rendering and prefers the current player response; preserves valid owner metadata across incomplete updates and clears it on navigation.
Ad handling selects the actual player instead of its outer wrapper, supports more mobile Skip controls and still attempts skipping when playback-rate changes are unsupported.
messages_media: Earlier history prefetch starts while scrolling within12 rows of the beginning, in40-message batches. The normal manual Load Earlier Messages stop is removed; a compact spinner and failure-only retry preserve recovery.
Attachment autoplay begins from prepared/surface/foreground readiness. Initial clip setup cannot pause the newly started player; dialog lifecycle readiness and later user pauses remain respected.

checks.fixed_javascript: Passed ad/unsupported-rate, metadata/current-owner, autoplay and viewport scenarios
checks.apk: Original Android signing certificate, SDK publisher/source provenance and16KiB native alignment verified
checks.live_sources: Apple search/chart/lookup HTTP200. Archive Mystery query returned878 recordings and a real12-chapter MP3 recording. LibriVox id52 returned200; other API requests returned403/500.

limits: Actual Samsung playback, scroll frame timing and live YouTube advertising/channel markup remain unverified. Automatic ad skipping is best effort.
The exact phone LibriVox error was not reproduced.
Podcast browsing includes a build-time popular snapshot; live keyword/topic results use the public directory. Public providers can be unavailable or rate limit requests.
